preconditions.description: The number of lines n is between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(op in ['&', '|', '^'] and 0 <= x <= 1023 for op, x in commands)
preconditions.description: Each command consists of an operator ('&', '|', '^') and a constant (0 ≤ x ≤ 1023).

postconditions.description: The length of the optimized program k is between 0 and 5.

postconditions.expression: all(op in ['&', '|', '^'] and 0 <= x <= 1023 for op, x in optimized_commands)
postconditions.description: Each command in the optimized program consists of an operator ('&', '|', '^') and a constant (0 ≤ x ≤ 1023).

postconditions.expression: all(apply_program(commands, i) == apply_program(optimized_commands, i) for i in range(1024))
postconditions.description: The optimized program returns the same integer as the original program for all arguments from 0 to 1023.
